issues.reason: A grammar-label-only answer may supply no interpretable operator meaning; the local defect example conflicts with the global unobservable-first decision rule.
issues.detector: Compare interpretable semantic components with the facet defer rule before assigning defect.

issues.reason: The reference partial response explicitly strengthens a possibility/frequency assertion while the same activity rubric and global policy classify strengthening as defect.
issues.detector: Normalize assertion strength for every partial/equivalent alternative; reject explicit strengthening as omission-based partial.

issues.reason: A grammar-name-only response without a boundary example conflicts with the example facet defer rule.
issues.detector: Separate unobserved required examples from explicit false examples.

issues.reason: Attachment-only prose supplies no required boundary classification; the defect example overlaps the no-boundary-response defer criterion.
issues.detector: Inspect the presence of interpretable boundary judgments; preserve omission/defer separately from distortion.

issues.reason: The rubric requires two distinctions between contextual interpretation and other performances, but the actual learner prompt does not request those distinctions.
issues.detector: Map every required rubric output to an explicit prompt instruction; missing instruction is a provider defect, not learner failure.
